description: This file defines the class 'actionCreateRecord', which extends 'actionBase'. It contains methods for generating HTML UI, executing the create record action including setting fields and relationships on new records, and copying email addresses. It is part of a module that manages action-related logic for creating records within the SuiteCRM system, particularly in the context of workflows or automation.

classes.name: actionCreateRecord
classes.description: A class to handle the creation of new records in SuiteCRM, supporting UI rendering, record creation, field setting, relationship linking, and email address copying.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns JavaScript files associated with the creation record action.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates HTML for editing/displaying the create record action form, including dropdowns and dynamic JavaScript.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the create record action, including instantiating new records, setting fields, relationships, and handling email copying.

methods.name: set_record
methods.description: Populates the fields of a new record based on parameters, handling different data types and special calculations.

methods.name: set_relationships
methods.description: Establishes relationships between the new record and other beans based on parameters.

methods.name: copyEmailAddresses
methods.description: Copies email addresses from one bean to another, validating addresses.

methods.name: validateCurrentEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates structure of an email address record.
